data.long_meaning: The name Gillie is derived from the Greek word γιλλα (gilla), which means 'pledge' or 'pledge-giver'. In ancient Greece, this name was given to children born during a time of war or conflict. Parents would make a vow to the gods, promising to dedicate their child to a god or to raise them with strong moral values. The name Gillie carries the meaning “Pledge, Pledge-giver” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gillie usually hope their child will grow to embody pledge, pledge-giver and live with faith, good character and purpose.
